_readme: Gold query set for e-Return retrieval eval. Same hybrid-strictness pattern as the BDRIS/NID/e-Passport suites, adapted for e-Return: because every e-Return record shares category=='faq', this suite gates on SUBCATEGORY (income_tax_general | online_return) — the meaningful coarse axis — via 'expected_subcategory', with 'expected_id' for record-level precision. min_similarity is a soft floor (WARN not FAIL). Includes one broad observational probe and one genuine out-of-scope probe. Built against the 83-record corpus with every expected_id validated to exist.
